planning_notes: No physical Serial reporting requirements were provided; therefore serial_channels is empty.

Button electrical polarity (active-high vs active-low) and pullup/ pulldown were not specified; assume catalog default behavior for digital_input (no explicit pullup/active_high override provided). The model should treat D2/D3 pressed as a true event according to the actual wiring chosen in hardware.
Counter initialization value is not specified in the prose; TM1637 initial value is set to 0 to match a reasonable startup state. Alarm lock and count reset behavior belong in SysML.
Buzzer tone frequency and duration are not specified; tone_output is present with initial=0 and the SysML model must set a frequency when alarm triggers.

LED behavior is defined as ON for even count and OFF for odd count. SysML must map parity to digital_output model boolean; initial=false corresponds to startup oddness assumption only (may be overridden by model immediately after startup).

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button D2: increment request (model event on press)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Button D3: decrement request; long-press resets alarm lock

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: LED: ON for even count, OFF for odd count

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer alarm tone (starts when count reaches 15, locked until reset)

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: Time delta since previous control step (for model scheduling and report cadence)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个交互式计数与报警系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 加一，D3 减一，数码管显示当前值；当计数为偶数时 LED 亮，为奇数时 LED 灭；当计数达到 15 时蜂鸣器报警并锁定计数，直到长按 D3 复位。

requirements.text: 设计一个交互式计数与报警系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 加一，D3 减一，数码管显示当前值；当计数为偶数时 LED 亮，为奇数时 LED 灭；当计数达到 15 时蜂鸣器报警并锁定计数，直到长按 D3 复位。
